retreats.title: Three-Day Retreat
retreats.headline: Three Days to Reconnect with Yourself
retreats.intro: A thoughtfully curated three-day experiential retreat designed to help you step away from everyday distractions and reconnect with your body, breath, nature and inner self.
retreats.image_alt: A group meditating in a circle on the bank of the Ganga at sunrise
includes: Progressive sessions combining yoga asanas, pranayama and meditation.
A mindful morning connection with the sacred Ganga.
Guided breathing practices to cultivate awareness and inner stillness.
Meditative experiences inspired by Earth, Water, Fire, Air and Space.
Mindful walking and connecting with the natural surroundings.
Hanuman Chalisa, devotional singing, clapping and dancing.
An experience of devotion, gratitude and traditional spiritual practices.
Meaningful acts of service and compassion.
Experience the beauty and spiritual atmosphere of the evening Ganga Aarti.
Collective experience sharing, reflection and gratitude.
retreats.experience: Three days of yoga, breathwork, nature, devotion and conscious living, creating space to slow down and reconnect.

retreats.title: Five-Day Retreat
retreats.headline: Five Days for a Deeper Journey Within
retreats.intro: An extended immersive experience offering more time for silence, self-observation, deeper yoga practices and exploration of the spiritual and natural beauty of Rishikesh.
retreats.image_alt: Sunrise over the hills from a temple above Rishikesh
gallery: Silence and meditation in a cave

includes: A dedicated day of Noble Silence supported by thoughtfully designed silence-based activities to reduce external distractions and encourage deeper self-observation.
Progressive guided sessions combining yoga asanas, pranayama and meditation.
Mindful Ganga dips and moments of stillness by the river.
Meditative experiences inspired by the five elements.
Explore different breathing techniques and develop greater breath awareness.
Bhakti Kirtan, Hanuman Chalisa, Havan and traditional rituals.
Mindful outdoor experiences amidst greenery and natural surroundings.

Visit spiritually significant and peaceful high-vibrational places around Rishikesh and its surroundings. This excursion combines sacred spaces, nature exploration, local experiences and the joy of travelling together.
Participate in meaningful acts of service and compassion.

Conclude the retreat with collective reflection, experience sharing and gratitude.
retreats.experience: Five immersive days combining silence, yoga, spirituality, nature and exploration, offering a deeper opportunity to disconnect from everyday routines and reconnect with yourself.
